SELECT 'APPR-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '-' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(DOC_NO, -4))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM TB_AM11M01 WHERE DOC_NO LIKE 'APPR-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '-%'
SELECT DOC_ID, DOC_NO, CO_CD, DOC_STATUS, CURR_LINE_SEQ, CURR_APPROVER_ID, DRA_USER_ID, ERP_BIZ_TYPE, ERP_BIZ_KEY FROM TB_AM11M01 WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId}

SELECT M.DOC_ID, M.DOC_NO, M.CO_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CO_CD) AS CO_NM, M.FORM_CD, NVL(F.FORM_NM, CASE WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0701' THEN '휴가신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5101' THEN '출장신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5102' THEN '출장복명서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0801' THEN '휴일대체근무신청서' ELSE M.FORM_CD END) AS FORM_NM, M.FORM_VER, M.DOC_TITLE, M.DOC_STATUS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.DOC_STATUS) AS DOC_STATUS_NM, M.DRA_USER_ID, M.DRA_USER_NM, M.DRA_DEPT_ID, M.DRA_DEPT_NM, M.DRA_LEVEL_CD, M.DRA_LEVEL_NM, M.DRA_DUTY_CD, M.DRA_DUTY_NM, TO_CHAR(M.DRAFT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DRAFT_DT, TO_CHAR(M.COMPLETE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS COMPLETE_DT, M.CURR_LINE_SEQ, M.CURR_APPROVER_ID, M.CURR_APPROVER_NM, M.SECURITY_LEVEL, M.RETENTION_PERIOD, /* Tibero CLOB 객체를 jsonView에 그대로 노출하지 않는다. */ DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(M.DOC_DATA_JSON, 4000, 1) AS DOC_DATA_JSON, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(M.DOC_RENDER_HTML, 4000, 1) AS DOC_RENDER_HTML, M.ERP_BIZ_TYPE, M.ERP_BIZ_KEY, M.CREAT_ID, TO_CHAR(M.CREAT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_AM11M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AM02M01 F ON M.FORM_CD = F.FORM_CD WHERE M.DOC_ID = #{docId} AND (M.DRA_USER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_AM11D01 P WHERE P.DOC_ID = M.DOC_ID AND (P.APPROVER_ID = #{userId} OR P.ACTUAL_USER_ID = #{userId})))

SELECT D.DOC_ID, D.LINE_SEQ, D.LINE_TYPE, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(D.LINE_TYPE) AS LINE_TYPE_NM, D.LINE_STATUS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(D.LINE_STATUS) AS LINE_STATUS_NM, D.APPROVER_ID, D.APPROVER_NM, D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM, D.LEVEL_CD, D.LEVEL_NM, D.DUTY_CD, D.DUTY_NM, D.ACTUAL_USER_ID, D.ACTUAL_USER_NM, D.ACTUAL_DEPT_ID, D.ACTUAL_DEPT_NM, D.ACTUAL_LEVEL_NM, D.DELEGATE_YN, TO_CHAR(D.APPR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS APPR_DT, D.APPR_OPINION, D.ARBIT_YN, D.WB20_TODO_KEY, D.WB20_CO_CD, D.WB20_TODO_NO, D.WB20_SANCTN_SN, D.WB20_DIV1_CODE_ID, D.WB20_DIV2_CODE_ID, CASE WHEN R.USER_ID IS NOT NULL OR (D.LINE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND D.APPROVER_ID = (SELECT X.DRA_USER_ID FROM TB_AM11M01 X WHERE X.DOC_ID = D.DOC_ID)) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_READ, CASE WHEN R.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(R.FIRST_READ_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN D.LINE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND D.APPROVER_ID = (SELECT X.DRA_USER_ID FROM TB_AM11M01 X WHERE X.DOC_ID = D.DOC_ID) THEN TO_CHAR(D.APPR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS FIRST_READ_DTTM, CASE WHEN R.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(R.LAST_READ_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN D.LINE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND D.APPROVER_ID = (SELECT X.DRA_USER_ID FROM TB_AM11M01 X WHERE X.DOC_ID = D.DOC_ID) THEN TO_CHAR(D.APPR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS LAST_READ_DTTM, CASE WHEN R.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(R.READ_CNT, 0) WHEN D.LINE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND D.APPROVER_ID = (SELECT X.DRA_USER_ID FROM TB_AM11M01 X WHERE X.DOC_ID = D.DOC_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS READ_CNT FROM TB_AM11D01 D LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AM11D03 R ON D.DOC_ID = R.DOC_ID AND D.APPROVER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE D.DOC_ID = #{docId} ORDER BY D.LINE_SEQ ASC

SELECT H.HIST_SEQ, H.DOC_ID, H.ACT_TYPE, CASE H.ACT_TYPE WHEN 'SUBMIT' THEN '상신' WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN '승인' WHEN 'REJECT' THEN '반려' WHEN 'ARBIT' THEN '전결' WHEN 'CANCEL' THEN '취소' WHEN 'DELEGATE' THEN '대결' WHEN 'POST_APPROVE' THEN '후결' WHEN 'LINE_CHANGE' THEN '결재선변경' ELSE NVL(FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(H.ACT_TYPE), H.ACT_TYPE) END AS ACT_TYPE_NM, H.ACT_USER_ID, NVL(H.ACT_USER_NM, U.NAME) AS ACT_USER_NM, NVL(H.ACT_DEPT_NM, D.DEPT_NM) AS ACT_DEPT_NM, NVL(H.ACT_LEVEL_NM, L.LEVEL_NM) AS ACT_LEVEL_NM, H.PREV_STATUS, CASE H.PREV_STATUS WHEN 'NEW' THEN '작성' WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN '임시저장' WHEN 'REQUEST' THEN '상신' WHEN 'PROGRESS' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'POST_PROGRESS' THEN '후결진행' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '완료' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '반려' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '취소' ELSE NVL(FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(H.PREV_STATUS), H.PREV_STATUS) END AS PREV_STATUS_NM, H.NEXT_STATUS, CASE H.NEXT_STATUS WHEN 'NEW' THEN '작성' WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN '임시저장' WHEN 'REQUEST' THEN '상신' WHEN 'PROGRESS' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'POST_PROGRESS' THEN '후결진행' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '완료' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '반려' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '취소' ELSE NVL(FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(H.NEXT_STATUS), H.NEXT_STATUS) END AS NEXT_STATUS_NM, H.ACT_OPINION, TO_CHAR(H.ACT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ACT_DTTM FROM TB_AM11D02 H LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM06M01 U ON H.ACT_USER_ID = U.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM07M01 L ON U.LEVEL_CD = L.LEVEL_CD WHERE H.DOC_ID = #{docId} ORDER BY H.HIST_SEQ ASC
